subject: very tall man
title: What If You Never Stopped Growing?

scenes.text: What if you never stopped growing? Your own size would turn against you.
One man lived it. Robert Wadlow's pituitary gland never switched off. He was six feet tall at eight.
At thirteen, 7 feet 4. At twenty-two, 8 feet 11, the tallest person ever measured.
His legs needed iron braces to walk, and he had little feeling left in his feet.
So he couldn't feel a brace rubbing his ankle raw. The blister became infected.
He died at 22, just days after his last measurement, and he was still growing.

description:
What if you never stopped growing? Robert Wadlow's overactive pituitary gland kept pushing out growth hormone: he was 6 feet tall at 8, 7 feet 4 at 13 and 8 feet 11.1 (272 cm) at 22, still the tallest person ever measured (Guinness World Records).
He needed leg braces and had little feeling in his feet; a poorly fitted brace caused a blister that became infected, and he died in 1940, 18 days after his final measurement, with no sign his growth had stopped.

first_comment: Would you want to be a few inches taller, or is your height just right? What body what-if should we do next?
